design: Additional diagnostic motivated by weak cross-layer increments. Recorded before computing frozen-geography scenarios.
fit: Existing 1999-2011 gravity coefficients; no refitting to these scenario outcomes.
factors: lagged research capacity geography, including candidate city support
four_scenarios: Early geography/early volume; early geography/late volume; late geography/early volume; late geography/late volume.
decomposition: Symmetric two-factor Shapley decomposition of the model change; exact expected active node counts and HHI; 30 fixed-total multinomial draws for positive-flow Gini and R.
interpretation: Conditional model reference. Predicted geography is external to this model, not a demonstrated endogenous mechanism. International distances remain approximate national centroids.
